I come here for all of my fish and dog needs. Today I came because my dog has a hematoma on his ear and his vet is closed until tomorrow so I needed a cone to keep him from irritating it more before I can get him seen. I walked up and down a few different aisles with no luck so I went to stand in line to ask someone where I could find it because there was no one walking around. After waiting for the person in front of me to do a return for a while I finally just asked if the cashier could tell me which aisle I could find the cones on to which she simply responded "the dog stuff is all on this side of the store" gesturing to the side. I walked up and down every aisle again with no luck still, went to sit in my car and got on the app to order it so I didn't have to keep looking. Waited at least another 30 minutes before I went inside to see how long the order would take, just one cone shouldn't be too hard to grab real quick, but the cashier just looked up the order and said it would still be a while but "most of the orders only take a couple of hours." I need the cone now and didn't want to keep sitting in the parking lot for two hours when I had already spent over an hour trying to get this dang cone so I called customer service to cancel it. I went to Petco instead and when I asked that cashier where I could find dog cones he walked me straight to them himself and I was in and out in less than 5 minutes. I'll go there first next time I guess, lesson learned.

Do not buy fish from this PetSmart unless you have a HUGE fish tank that meets their standards.

I came here with my daughter to buy a few fish, and the experience was extremely frustrating. We waited for a long time, and eventually I had to go look for an employee myself before anyone came to help us.

When an employee finally came over, she told me my aquarium was too small. I explained that my tank is at least 15 gallons, actually more than that. I even showed her the approximate size with my hands, but she insisted that it was only about 10 gallons.

I already have one black glofish shark with a red tail that I’ve had for about a year, along with four small fish. I wanted to add a pink fish, a gold fish, and the three other small gold fish that were in the same store tank.

She absolutely refused to sell me even one fish, saying my tank was too small and that adding another fish would cause oxygen problems.

I wanted to add 5 more fish（cause buy 4 the 5th free）, including a pink one and a gold one. She refused to sell me even one fish, insisting that my tank was too small and that the fish would not have enough oxygen.

What I find ridiculous is that the fish at this store are kept in tiny tanks with multiple fish crowded together. Those tanks look smaller than my filter box, yet somehow customers are expected to have huge aquariums at home.

If you’re going to enforce strict standards for fish welfare, that’s fine—but those standards should be applied consistently.

So, keep your fish. I won’t be buying fish from this location again.

Went to petsmart to buy an angel fish. I asked what seemed like a young girl named Zack for help. She was stocking merchandise at the time.  Seemed very annoyed with me asking. She asked what did I need I asked her to see if she could help me with a purchase of an 1 angel fish and I pointed out to her the one I wanted. She asked me how big my aquarium was? I said 40 gallons. She immediately said no. I asked why? she said I cannot sale you one because it's under 50 gallons. I thought she was joking but walked off. I went to the front and asked for a manager so I can see the rules on buying an angel fish under 50 gallons. After a long wait the manager came and said that he had read the rules but could not show me because of petsmart policy. I reached the web to see what the rules are on petsmart selling an angel fish with less then 50 gallons. Nothing found of course. I just feel that they didn't want to take the time to net that particular angel fish out of 10 that were in the aquarium.  So I put aqurium plants, food and ph medicine that I had in my hand and walked away with no purchase. Went down to petco on veterans and 1960 asked them. They said it was the most ridiculous thing they have heard. They were super happy to help me and made several purchases there. NO THANKS to petsmart. if you need me to change to 5 star please show me the rules of buying an angel fish with less than 50 gallons. Ill be waiting!!!!!!!!
